_about: The owner's public profile page (profile/?u=owner). Edit this file to change it. Banner: by default it plays the 'featured' episode from the playlist (muted, looping; Sound / Full screen / Playlist buttons on top). To use something else, set banner to a path inside the site: an .mp4/.webm video, an animated .gif/.webp, or a still .jpg/.png (blank = use the featured episode, or the animated placeholder if there are no episodes). Bump bannerVersion whenever you replace a file so browsers load the new one. Playlist: add more episodes as more {title, video, poster, length} entries; a video can be an .mp4 or a .json list of parts (big videos are stored in pieces). avatar = optional photo path for visitors (blank = initials). Social links with an empty url stay hidden; types: youtube, tiktok, instagram, discord, x, twitch, roblox, github, website. Links must start with https://
